comment_data.body:
I have one question though. In code.pyx there is a method:
https://github.com/cython/cython/blob/fcee6d0a8aaf7ed428c62c98cab355cfc9009755/Cython/Compiler/Code.py#L2965-L2969

But in other places is used "naked" likely/unlikely - e.g. here:

https://github.com/cython/cython/blob/fcee6d0a8aaf7ed428c62c98cab355cfc9009755/Cython/Compiler/Code.py#L3320

Hence, it means that even user provides `gcc_branch_hints`, not all `likely/unlikely` are eliminated. Is it intentional? Or it is a "bug"?

comment_data.body: I think we automatically inject `unlikely()` these days when we detect that the branch only raises an exception. Same for the `FusedFunction.pyx` cases, I don't think these are needed.
